register.title: Registration form
register.intro: Complete this form and our team will contact you with next steps.
register.successText: We received your information and will contact you shortly.

registerFlow.introBody: Welcome to the pre-registration form. Complete each step with accurate information. Our team will review your application and contact you about admission and payment.
registerFlow.checklistIntro: Please confirm each point. Training is offered at our center in Cotonou.
checklistItems: I understand that courses are delivered in person at Cedar Training Center in Cotonou.
I understand that fees and schedules will be confirmed by the center after my application is reviewed.
I agree to provide accurate personal and contact information.
registerFlow.educationLevelIntro: Tell us where you are in your education right now (one answer is enough).
registerFlow.educationLevelPlaceholder: e.g. Final year of secondary school, completed BAC, first year at university, working and studying part-time…

discovery.label: How did you hear about us?

registerFlow.securityNote: Never share passwords or full bank card numbers through this form.
registerFlow.successBody: Your pre-registration was saved. You may take the optional English placement test now or return later using the same link from your confirmation email.
